text: Title card: faint ghosted duplicate text (e.g. 'of strange loops' after 'Tangle.', lines under the description and Begin button, a dark box at right) shows through behind the card text
Hub at spawn: an empty black rectangle sits at top-centre (x~370-910, y~45-95), overlapping and cutting off the NEXT objective line ('...then take the [hidden] left.')

Screen room: on reaching 6 of 6 levels, the explanatory caption 'A picture that contains itself... That's self-reference.' (tick 19923) was replaced by 'Now the sentences...' at tick 20358, only ~7 game seconds later; I never saw it on screen. No debrief card for the screen part.

Lectern FALSE button prompt reads 'E: this sentence is false' - the exact wording of the liar paradox, so the answer button itself reads like one of the puzzle sentences. Suggest 'E: answer FALSE' or 'E: the sentence is false'.

Sentence 5 of 5 'This sentence is false.' Pressing CAN'T BE EITHER (the correct answer) at tick 54427 was refused: 'Not yet: this one only lights when a sentence can't be answered either way.' That is exactly what this sentence is, so the message contradicts itself; it seems the game wants TRUE and FALSE tried first but never says so.

Staircase: after running ~8s from the door (Shift+w), the NEXT objective switched to the Machine room's 'Read the board. If you're convinced MU can't be made, press the red button beside it.' and the caption became 'From up here you can see the machine from outside...' while still in the stairwell (room=stair, stairs.loops=-1, y=4.45). I have not been in the Machine room at all.
